生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER, RIVEN'S ISOLATED FOREST CABIN, and WOODEN TRAINING SWORD references.

Keep Riven's exact face, pale-blonde hair, body proportions, clothing, and overall appearance consistent with the RIVEN — TWO YEARS LATER reference.

Keep the isolated cabin, outdoor clearing, surrounding mountain forest, terrain, vegetation, and overall atmosphere consistent with the cabin environment reference.

The wooden training sword must remain the same large, broad, two-handed wooden practice sword shown in its reference.

=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Grounded photorealistic realism.

Cold early morning in an isolated mountain forest.

Soft overcast natural light.

Thin mist drifting between the trees.

Natural human movement.

Realistic two-handed sword practice.

Restrained cinematic camera movement.

Natural cinematic cuts.

No dialogue.

No subtitles.

No background music.

Use only natural sound:

cold mountain wind,
moving grass,
distant birds,
forest ambience,
Riven's distant training shouts,
her breathing,
footsteps on dirt,
and the wooden training sword moving through the air.

The overall atmosphere is quiet, lonely, reflective, and slightly melancholic.

The first part of the scene should establish that Riven still remembers the two people she lost.

Then gradually reveal the solitary life she now lives.

=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Two years have passed.

Begin near Riven's isolated cabin with a simple memorial.

Two old swords are planted vertically into the earth beside each other.

They represent the two people Riven lost:

her father,
and the young soldier who became like a brother to her.

Keep the memorial simple and grounded.

After briefly showing the two swords, move through several quick views of the cold mountain wilderness.

Riven is still unseen.

Then her distant training shout echoes through the forest.

The sound of a large wooden practice sword follows.

The camera gradually moves toward the sound.

Through the trees, reveal the isolated cabin.

Beside it, Riven is training alone with her large wooden practice sword.

Her movements are controlled, experienced, and disciplined.

This is her normal morning routine after two years of isolation.

=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — THE MEMORIAL

Begin very close to the cold earth.

Wet grass moves gently in the morning wind.

Thin mist passes slowly across the ground.

The camera slowly rises.

Reveal two old swords planted vertically into the earth beside each other.

The swords form a simple handmade memorial.

One represents Riven's father.

The other represents the young soldier who became her close companion.

Keep the design understated.

These are two different swords belonging to two different people.

They are NOT Riven's Broken Sword.

They are NOT wooden training swords.

They are old personal swords left here as memorial markers.

A small weathered strip of cloth is tied around one sword.

A different simple military cloth strip is tied around the other.

Both have been exposed to the mountain weather for some time.

There are no large gravestones.

No elaborate cemetery.

No modern objects.

No written text is necessary.

Only the two swords standing quietly beside each other.

The forest and pale morning mist fill the background.

No person is visible.

Only the sound of wind.

Hold briefly.

Then—

from somewhere far away in the forest:

"HAH!"

A distant training shout.

Silence again.

Then faintly:

WHOOSH.

The sound of a large wooden practice sword moving through the air.

Another distant:

"HAH!"

CUT.

=== Shot 2 — THE MOUNTAINS ===

Cut to a brief wide cinematic view of the remote mountain wilderness.

Forest-covered slopes disappear into pale morning mist.

Clouds hang low around the mountains.

No houses or people are immediately visible.

Riven's training sounds continue faintly somewhere in the distance.

WHOOSH.

A short training shout echoes softly through the valley.

CUT.

=== Shot 3 — FOLLOW THE SOUND ===

Move into the forest.

The camera travels naturally between tall tree trunks.

Morning mist hangs low between them.

The training sounds gradually become clearer.

Riven's breathing can now occasionally be heard.

WHOOSH.

"HAH!"

Footsteps moving across dirt.

Another controlled movement of the wooden sword.

The camera continues toward the sound.

Through gaps between the trees, the isolated cabin gradually becomes visible.

Beside the cabin is the small outdoor training clearing.

At first, only a distant moving figure can be seen.

Continue closer.

The figure becomes recognizable as Riven.

CUT.

=== Shot 4 — RIVEN ===

Reveal Riven clearly for the first time.

Use a cinematic medium-wide composition.

She is alone in the training clearing beside the cabin.

Riven holds the large wooden training sword with both hands.

She settles naturally into her stance.

Then she begins another familiar practice sequence.

A strong diagonal swing.

WHOOSH.

A short natural training shout:

"HAH!"

She controls the momentum.

Her feet reposition naturally across the earth.

She turns with the large wooden sword.

Then performs another broad two-handed practice swing.

The sword should feel large and substantial.

Riven uses her legs, hips, shoulders, and both hands together to guide its weight.

Her movements are clean and experienced.

She has clearly repeated this routine many times.

=== Shot 5 — THE ROUTINE ===

Continue with a short, readable training sequence.

Keep the choreography simple.

Riven changes stance.

A controlled swing.

A natural turn.

Another two-handed practice movement.

A precise stop.

Then she resets again.

Occasionally move closer to show small details:

her boots moving across the worn training ground,

both hands firmly controlling the wooden grip,

the broad wooden blade passing through the cold morning air,

loose strands of pale-blonde hair moving around her face,

and her calm focused expression.

Her breathing remains controlled.

The training is serious and disciplined, but not unusually intense yet.

This is simply the routine she follows every morning.

=== Shot 6 — ALONE ===

Gradually move away from Riven.

Transition into a wider composition.

Riven continues practicing.

WHOOSH.

"HAH!"

The isolated cabin stands behind her.

Beyond the cabin are only trees, mist, and mountains.

There are no other people around her.

Slowly pull farther back.

Riven becomes smaller within the landscape.

Her training continues while the camera moves away.

Her footsteps, breathing, wooden sword movements, and occasional training shouts echo softly through the otherwise quiet forest.

End with Riven still training alone beside the cabin.

CUT.、16:9
